verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports low overhead. The architecture docs say the control plane stays out of the data path, metrics separate LLM request latency from upstream provider processing time (so overhead can be measured), and semantic caching can cut provider round-trips. No doc states, quantifies, or benchmarks the gateway's added latency. Missing for 10: explicit low-overhead or performance claims, published latency benchmarks, independent or hands-on measurements of proxy overhead.
